How risk is defined

Two signals, 0–2 points each

Signal0 pts1 pt2 pts
Attendance≥ 75%60–75%< 60%
Performance index*≥ 7060–70< 60
  • Low 0–1 points
  • Medium 2 points
  • High 3–4 points
*Weighted average of midterm 25%, final 30%, assignments 15%, quizzes 10%, projects 15%, participation 5%. The dataset's own Total_Score and Grade columns don't follow the component scores, so they are not used to define risk.
